prior_layout_comparison.changes: Restore the USB return stitch; add two PD transfer vias and a 0.5 mm B.Cu parallel path around the relocated D20 corner. Other power corridors retain the existing rule/width policy.

changes: DRV8262DDVR plus MCP4822/current references and stocked R60/BZ1/U36/R66 replacements. Preserve motor/brake corridors, Kelvin branches and USB return reference. Add 1.35 mm B.Cu PD parallel conductor, 1.5 mm inner transfer tracks and four power-transfer vias to offset the local U36 routing detour.
